reason: The aluminium already comes with factory film, and if it gets scratched or covered in cement the supplier or the glazing installer deals with it. I am not adding a new supplier and a new cost line of about 19 euro per m2 for that, with a 50% deposit up front, on thin margins.
objection: I already get factory film on the frames, so I would be paying twice for protection. At about 19 euro per m2 plus a deposit, it eats margin on every job.
instead: Keep the factory film, tape and cardboard on the frames, and have my own labourers wipe the glass down at the end. Buy cheap local protection film if I need extra.
would_change_my_mind: Proof on a premium block that the factory film fails often enough to cost me more in callbacks and cleaning than this does, plus a price under about 6 euro per m2 with 60-day terms and no deposit.
